prompt: Run the llm-working2grid ablation baseline for as-sgp-singapore (variant orig) with --model=opus5: assign every classified node an integer grid cell from scratch and apply.

transcript.note: Line-corridor octolinear, built straight off the working map. Different design point from llm-skeleton2grid on purpose: that chain has a rank-snapping control whose meanDrift it must beat, so it stays near-proportional; this chain has no control at all (criterion: 'no rank-snapping baseline to fight'), so I spent the freedom on criterion 4 and squeezed hard -- 45x46 instead of a near-proportional canvas, with the long low-degree branches compressed. Method, in the order the criteria give: (1) Interchanges first. The 34 deg>=3 nodes were placed before anything else, because edge winding order is only defined there and it is the only hard reject. (2) One line, one axis, laid along each route's seq. NEL gets the clean vertical: Chinatown-Clarke Quay-57-Dhoby Ghaut all share column 24, which is what the geography actually says (gx 590/597/595/594) and buys three consecutive verticals. That decision costs [37,41] and [41,57], because Fort Canning has to step out to column 23 or the Chinatown-Fort Canning line would run straight through Clarke Quay -- a deliberate trade, three verticals for two. EWL gets the row-6 waterfront run Outram Park-Maxwell-52-50-53-Bayfront (five horizontals) and the row-24 western run Tuas Link-Pioneer-Jurong East. NSL gets column 27/28 through the CBD and row 0 along the Marina reclamation (HarbourFront-Marina Bay-Marina South Pier). CCL's north side becomes row 29 (Marymount-Bishan-Serangoon) and its east side column 33 (Paya Lebar-MacPherson-Serangoon). DTL's north-west branch becomes column 16 (Buona Vista-Botanic Gardens-Beauty World-Bukit Panjang, sharing the TEL Woodlands column), and its CBD hook becomes the row-13 band Fort Canning-57-54-City Hall-51-Promenade, five more horizontals. TEL gets column 22 Outram Park-Orchard-Newton. (3) Criterion 3 is unmeasured on this chain, so I enforced it by construction anyway: column is a weakly monotone function of gx and row of gy, which makes an E/W or N/S inversion impossible. Verified 0 flips against geography before handing over. (4) One crossing cluster had to be fixed by hand: with Caldecott pulled up into the row-24 band, the Newton-Bishan edge sliced through all four of Caldecott's edges (4 crossings). Moving Bishan and its gx-tied column-mates 54/38/56 one column east to 26 drops the edge below the Caldecott fan and clears all four. Result: hv 53 of 87, cross 0, vtxOn 0, collide 0, on a 45x46 grid.
